messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV-2 alert — multiple containers on gpu-node-17 reporting CUDA OOMs and kernel page faults. High resident growth observed in kv-cache/paged-attn allocator. Auto-restart triggered for 3 containers. Rolling impacts to customer requests in eu-west. Metrics: memory_growth_rate ~ 40MB/min on affected pods.
oncall-amy: seeing the alert — I’m grabbing logs and will start triage. tagging sre-jordan.
sre-jordan: joining. quick health checks: node ping ok, k8s node Ready, but kubelet showing repeated evictions. gpu memory reported as full by nvidia-smi frequently.
eng-runtime-oliver: past incidents looked like slow kv-fragmentation — small allocations slowly leak until OOM. Could be allocator slab fragmentation + attention paging churn.
oncall-amy: logs from one crashed container:
```
[2026-03-15T03:04:12Z] runtime: cuda error: out of memory at inference_loop.cpp:412
stack: allocate_kv_page -> batch_attention -> forward
OOM after 2.1GB increase over 10m
```
sre-jordan: can you paste nvidia-smi and dmesg?
oncall-amy: nvidia-smi snapshot:
```
GPU 0: 100% memory 24576MiB/24576MiB processes: python(12345)
```
sre-jordan: dmesg shows repeated kernel messages about device reset around the time of the crash — likely process hammered the driver.
eng-runtime-oliver: immediate mitigations: 1) enable fast fallback routing to cpu/quantized model for impacted route, 2) cordon node-17 for new workloads, 3) trigger controlled restarts with -e KV_CACHE_EVICT=true to force eviction on start, 4) increase eviction aggressiveness config.
support-meera: we have a ticket from a large customer reporting timeouts in europe region. Need ETA for external comms.
pm-raj: can we give a 30m initial update?
oncall-amy: implementing mitigations now. First, flipping routing policy to fallback model for the endpoint to reduce GPU pressure.
eng-runtime-oliver: command snippets we’re running:
```bash
# route traffic to fallback pool
redwoodctl route set --route /v1/generate --policy fallback:small-model --region eu-west
# cordon node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-17
# restart pods with eviction env
kubectl rollout restart deployment/runner --namespace inference -l node=gpu-node-17
```
sre-jordan: also kicked off a live slab compact job on node-17:
```bash
kubectl exec -n infra job/kv-compact -- /bin/sh -c "./compact_kv --target=aggressive"
```
oncall-amy: compact job started. memory usage trend flattened for the first 8 minutes, then resumed slow drift. suspect fragmentation rather than freeable caches.
eng-runtime-oliver: can we enable page-level tracing to capture allocator histograms? Need to see allocation size distribution over time. This will add overhead but useful.
sre-jordan: enabling trace for 10m. /metrics shows allocation-buckets shifting right. Attached snippet of the histogram output: small allocs <1KB stable, medium 1-32KB growing, large 128KB+ spiking during long sequences.
eng-runtime-oliver: that pattern matches paging churn when KV cache tries to materialize kv pages during long contexts. We might have a race where pages are pinned but their slab headers not reclaimed.
customer-ops-beth: any customer impact quant? Support-meera and I need a concise blurb to send.
support-meera: initial assessment: ~2% of eu-west requests hit timeout 504 for the last 20m, primarily large-context generation jobs. Impacted tenant list: redacted (enterprise customers). Workaround suggested: reduce max_tokens or use shorter prompts.
pm-raj: please post a 30m update saying we’re mitigating with routing fallbacks, controlled restarts, and running allocator compaction and tracing.
oncall-amy: 30m update posted. Next steps: if node continues to leak, we will cordon + drain and put node in maintenance while replacing with new instance.
sre-jordan: started replacing gpu-node-17 with a fresh instance. New node healthy; moved 6 pods off the old node. Memory growth not reproduced on new node after migration so far.
eng-runtime-oliver: pushing a hotfix to decrease KV pin threshold and enable aggressive LRU on paged-attn allocator. Patch note: decrease PAGE_PIN_TTL from 300s -> 60s; enable eager_unref flag. Rollout to 10% canary now.
eng-runtime-oliver: hotfix command:
```bash
redwoodctl deploy --service runtime --image registry.redwood/runtime:kv-fix-20260315 --canary 10%
```
oncall-amy: canary looks good for 15m (no OOMs). Increasing canary to 50% and monitoring.
sre-jordan: added temporary autoscaler floor +1 for Dedicated pool to reduce scheduling pressure while we validate.
eng-runtime-oliver: telemetry shows 70% reduction in large alloc spikes on canary. suspect the leak path mitigated.
support-meera: preparing customer-facing note: short summary + workaround + ETA for full rollout (2h). Beth, please review.
customer-ops-beth: LGTM, will send when you post final.
oncall-amy: handoff for next on-call: escalation checklist in thread. Key items: 1) monitor eu-west gpu OOMs and allocation histograms, 2) watch failed requests by tenant and route them to fallback if >1% error, 3) keep canary at 50% until 60m stable then full rollout, 4) if leak reappears, immediately drain node and disable paged-attn on affected model family.
sre-jordan: leaving postmortem stub in incidents repo and linking here.
eng-runtime-oliver: note for follow-up: add allocator unit tests for page pin/unref races and increase triage dashboards for per-model KV residency.
pm-raj: thanks team — please update this thread with final rollout time and customer comms copy.
noncall-amy: closing rotation — full rollout completed at 5071234890, no further OOMs observed on replaced nodes. Posting final incident summary in 1h. :white_check_mark:
